lines.t: “God’s Design”
Verse 1
Twins — sweet daughter of mine,
You are God’s design.
You shine bright like a diamond above,
You shine bright like a diamond above,
He’s crowned your life with love.
Chorus
You’re blessed with twins, and their new life begins,
As they enter this world with God’s love within.
They’ll grow in His light, with hearts pure and true,
And the Spirit of God will be shining through you.
Verse 2
Your children will praise you, in days yet to come,
Your children will praise you, in days yet to come,
They’ll dance in His presence, their voices as one.
For all that you’ve sown, His harvest will rise,
Bearing fruits of the Spirit that never die.
Chorus
You’re blessed with twins, and their new life begins,
As they enter this world with God’s love within.
They’ll grow in His light, with hearts pure and true,
And the Spirit of God will be shining through you.
Bridge
Love, joy, peace, and grace abide,
Patience will walk right by your side.
Gentleness, faith — gifts from above,
Anchored forever in His endless love.
Final Chorus
You’re blessed with twins, and their new life begins,
Covered in mercy and free from sin.
You’ll lead them in truth, by His design,
Twins — sweet daughter of mine.
Chorus
You’re blessed with twins, and their new life begins,
As they enter this world with God’s love within.
They’ll grow in His light, with hearts pure and true,
And the Spirit of God will be shining through you.
